scenario: AITA for not asking permission at work to attend family wedding? | I've been with the company for over 13 years. Hard worker, never makes a fuss. Do my job, help out extra nights and weekends when needed. Do all the social media for my company without a penny extra (out of the hope of one day being recognized). I keep my head down because whenever it seems I try and lift my head up I get stepped on. People take long lunches, dress casual, take advantage. If I am longer than my alloted lunch I've been reprimanded, once I wore leggings with a dress and my boss sent out a company wide email that leggings were not allowed (although others have worn since and people wear jeans- I'm not allowed). I know thats not rational because I have bills and family that I can't go without a solid paycheck for too long. My parents think I'm the asshole because I didn't ask permission. My co-worker thinks they are being unfair to me because she was allowed to take two 2 week vacations.
